item.title: Tibetans Strive to Preserve Language and Culture Under China's Unity Law
item.description: A retired nurse's effort to learn written Tibetan highlights the ongoing struggle to maintain cultural identity.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed Wins Michigan Democratic Senate Primary
item.description: El-Sayed, an epidemiologist, advocates for Medicare for All and opposes corporate influence in politics, defeating Rep. Haley Stevens.

item.title: Pakistan's ruling party leads in Kashmir vote despite boycott call by banned group
item.description: Candidates from Nawaz Sharif's party won 24 of 34 seats in the first round of Kashmir elections, despite a boycott by a banned group.

item.title: How Trump made an estimated $2.2 billion during the first year of his second term
item.description: New York Times reporter Eric Lipton discusses his Pulitzer-winning investigation into Trump's conflicts of interest and whether he is exploiting his office.
